To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

MCL-1 inhibition sensitizes BCL2 NHL cells to venetoclax; BCL-XL is the driver of navitoclax synergy with A-121047; BCL-X inhibition may provide an alternative treatment strategy for BCL2 NHLs that are not sensitive to venetoclaz; and BCL-XL may also be a target for combination therapy in BCL2 cells.
MCL-2 and BCL- 2 are the two anti-apoptotic proteins that need to be inhibited in order to sensitize BCL2 NHL cells to BCL-2 inhibition.
